messages:
kai: spotting repeated OOM spikes on prod-rt pool over the last 20m. flamegraph shows kernel_selector choosing the new fused-attn kernel for long-context requests and memory climbs until allocator fails. attaching short profiler snippet and peak mem log.

matt: ugh, is this the kernel autotune landed in canary yesterday?

kai: yep, rollout to 10% yesterday morning. spike correlates w/ increased long-token chat traffic. sample trace: `seq_len=4096, batch=3 -> workspace requested 7.1GB, reserved 0.9GB, fail at 6.8GB`.

anna: priority mitigation: route latency-critical routes to quantized-small model variant + enforce token cap while we triage. also reduce max_batch_size on that pool to stop big batch aggregation.

matt: agree. immediate steps I propose (order):
1) quick route-level switch to small-model variant for `chat-low-latency`
2) change pool config: `max_batch_tokens: 16384` -> `8192`, `max_batch_size: 12` -> `8`
3) enable aggressive KV eviction threshold (evict when kv_fill > 0.55)
4) bump allocator soft_reserve from 150MB -> 300MB so kernel selector has some headroom

kai: + add a circuit-breaker to drop requests > 6k tokens for 5m if mem pressure > 0.75. fallback to smaller model if circuit trips.

sara: I can push the route switch and pool change. running dry-run first.

sara: DRY-RUN output:
```
$ rbctl route update --name chat-low-latency --model redwood-small-q4f
DRY RUN: route change validated, no policy violations
$ rbctl pool update --pool prod-rt-1 --set max_batch_size=8 --set max_batch_tokens=8192
DRY RUN: pool config diff generated
```

sara: applying now:
```
$ rbctl route apply --name chat-low-latency --model redwood-small-q4f
OK: route updated
$ rbctl pool apply --pool prod-rt-1 --set max_batch_size=8 --set max_batch_tokens=8192
OK: pool config applied
```

deploy-bot: config-change: route/chat-low-latency updated by sara at 2026-03-18T15:17Z; pool/prod-rt-1 updated by sara

infra-bot: current mem summary after changes:
- prod-rt-1 1m avg util: 62% -> now 45%
- kv cache hit-rate unchanged (0.78) but kv memory usage dropped ~18% due to eviction window

matt: good. still need kernel-side fix: put a guard in kernel_selector to prefer fallback kernels when workspace_estimate > 0.6 * free_device_mem or if predicted growth rate > X. that's a code change but low-risk patch we can hotfix.

anna: also add a short-term request-shaping rule in the API gateway: if tokens_requested > 3000 and route == chat-low-latency -> return 429 with friendly message and recommend using `max_tokens` param. simpler than silent drops.

kai: actionable checklist for incident doc (so we can close once stable):
- [ ] validate changes kept mem under 70% for 30m
- [ ] add regression test: replay long-token traces against kernel_selector autotune variant
- [ ] implement kernel_selector headroom guard (PR + canary)
- [ ] instrument an early-warning alert for kernel memory curves (slope > threshold)
- [ ] update runbook to include route switch + pool throttle steps

sara: created incident ticket INF-4512 and attached profiler + the rbctl commands. assigning to matt for kernel patch and to anna for API gateway shaping rule.

matt: i'll open PR for kernel guard this afternoon, will flag for urgent review.

kai: thanks team. for follow-up, let's keep this thread for status updates. if any regression after the patch, escalate to paging. :thumbsup:

anna: agreed. I'll draft the short user-facing note for the 429 behavior.

sara: monitoring board alert threshold updated: prod-rt-1 mem > 72% for 3m -> P2 channel.

kai: closing loop: current tail OOMs dropped to zero in last 12m after changes. will wait 30m then move to postmortem stage.
